prompts.activity:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is an identity/style reference, not a layout to reproduce. Draw NEW animation frames of only this same adult character.
Output exactly ONE sheet of 20 separate full-body figures in a strict invisible 4-column by 5-row grid, read row-major. Aim at 1536×2304 pixels or the largest supported portrait resolution. Each equal cell contains one complete figure, centered, same camera distance and scale, feet at the same low baseline. Preserve generous transparent gutters and all hair, fingers, props and shoe tips fully inside their own cell. Fixed front three-quarter view, no camera change. Human adult stylized game proportions, not chibi.
Style: refined high-detail Japanese pixel illustration, clean dark pixel contours, carefully clustered highlights, natural anatomical hands, readable face, subtle pixel texture matching the reference. Preserve small fabric folds, seams, buckles, glasses or headphones, jewelry, and high-quality shading. No smooth vector simplification.
Background MUST be genuinely transparent alpha, never a drawn checkerboard. No ground plane, no cast shadow outside the sprite, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no borders, no numbers, no duplicate figures. Exactly 20 original distinct drawings. Consecutive frames must have physically different limb/hand/prop positions with coherent smooth motion; do not repeat, mirror or merely resize a drawing.

Identity: An adult anime woman with a long deep violet high side ponytail falling on image-left, violet eyes, two small gold earrings, black-and-purple headphones around her neck, oversized purple zip hoodie with silver drawstrings, black crop top, black cuffed shorts with belt and thigh straps, dark semi-sheer tights, chunky purple-and-white sneakers. Match the exact reference's face, hair, outfit stitching, proportions, and pixel palette. The laptop is matte black with a small purple rabbit emblem.
Animation ordering: frames 0–9 form one coherent WORKING sequence, frames 10–19 one coherent THINKING sequence. Maintain her prop in every frame. Each following numbered instruction describes its corresponding cell, but DO NOT draw the numbers.
0: left arm steadies open laptop, right hand settles over keyboard
1: right index presses a key, shoulders lean slightly toward screen
2: right middle finger presses next key, wrist slightly raised
3: both wrists adjust over laptop, concentrated forward gaze
4: right fingers spread while rapidly typing, ponytail sways slightly
5: right hand slides to trackpad, left shoulder lifts laptop a little
6: right index taps trackpad, eyes track across screen
7: right wrist sweeps back to keys, torso straightens slightly
8: right index presses return, eyebrows lift attentively
9: right fingers lift in a small typing pause, laptop held steady
10: left arm supports laptop, right hand lifts slowly away from keyboard
11: right hand halfway toward chin, head tilts slightly
12: right index touches lower lip, eyes looking up-right
13: right index rests on chin, brow slightly furrowed
14: right knuckles support chin, head leans a little deeper
15: right hand opens beside cheek as a possible idea occurs
16: right index raised halfway, laptop shifts closer to body
17: right index points up gently, eyes brighten in concentration
18: right index lowers toward laptop while looking back at screen
19: right hand returns near keyboard, thoughtful mouth closed
